cause.what_happened: This is day two of a collapse with no news behind it. On 2026-09-28 NCI fell 83.75% from a $14.65 prior close, and 73% of that came in the regular session with no catalyst reported. It was the day the company held its AGM, at 15:00 HKT (03:00 ET, before the US open). The AGM voted on a special resolution to make AGMs optional and to strip the new CEO's super-voting Class B shares of conversion, dividend and liquidation rights. Today it gapped a further 43%, went through volatility halts and bounced 21% off the open by the 15:04 ET screen.

140,000 Class B shares at 30 votes each issued to the new CEO Pengfei Jiang at par ($350), giving him about 64.0% of voting power. Class A outstanding was 2,364,282

findings.finding: The effective $100M F-3 shelf (EFFECT 2026-07-30) lets the issuer price a registered direct or shelf takedown tonight worth about twice today's market cap, because the baby-shelf limit is measured on the float within the 60 days before a sale, that is at pre-crash prices; the issuer sold $8.1M of stock in February 2026.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The shelf is already effective, so a takedown needs only a 424B5 supplement and a 6-K, which can be filed and priced overnight and hit the 2026-09-30 session. No ATM agreement is on file (the F-3 names no sales agent), so any sale would be a discrete priced deal and not a trickle.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The February 2026 offering was priced on 2026-02-09, and the baseline shows 2026-02-10 at -29.73%, followed by +238.46% the next session. So this stock's own reaction to a priced deal was about -30% on the day.
findings.why_not_priced: The price reflects the collapse, but not a deal that has not been announced. If a takedown were expected, the stock would not have bounced 21% off today's open into the screen. It would be pinned near the low, since any buyer tonight faces up to about $7.9–9.5M of possible supply against a roughly $3.9M market cap.
findings.independence: The issuer has raised money before: the $8.1M public offering of 14.85M shares at $0.5454, priced 2026-02-09 and closed 2026-02-11 (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/NCI/neo-concept-international-group-holdings-limited-announces-closing-ytslvu2zvt79.html). Nothing from a different source says a new deal is in preparation.

outside_window.finding: Governance entrenchment: the CEO holds about 64% of the vote through $350 of Class B shares issued under home-country practice, and the AGM of 2026-09-28 was asked to make AGMs optional. That is a long-horizon discount on the Class A shares, not an overnight catalyst.
Rosen Law Firm's securities class action investigation, announced 2026-04-09. It is old, carries no docket date, and a filed complaint would land at an unknown date.

Listing risk if the price keeps falling toward $1: the bid-price clock would take 30 business days to trigger and is not running now, since spot is $1.64. The 8-for-1 consolidation of May 2026 is the issuer's precedent for fixing it.
